text:
tim_sales: FYI Cornerstone Bank pushed back on our standard answers. They require BYOK with split-key (dual control), automatic 30-day rotation, signed rotation proofs, and a 90-day decrypt-only retention window. Want a POC in 3 weeks. Can SE confirm feasibility (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and minimal artifact list?

alex_solutions: Quick summary: Private = yes (we can integrate with on-prem HSM or cloud HSM with split-import). Dedicated = maybe if they host the HSM in their VPC and we only run a proxy. Hosted = cannot meet split-key dual-control guarantees today.

raja_sec: Security notes: dual-control means Redwood must not hold full CMK plaintext. Need defined key-share flow, HSM attestation, signed rotation events (seq# + timestamp), and immutable audit logs (WORM). Ask their auditors for FIPS level (140-2 L3 vs 140-3).

tim_sales: They want us to sign a "no-plaintext" statement for the POC. Is that OK?

ella_engineer: We can commit in Private if the HSM performs unwrap/wrap and we never export cleartext. Implementation pattern: accept wrapped key shares, perform split-import in the HSM, register a key-id. Runtime must support key-versioned envelopes.

kyle_infra: Network checklist for POC: VPC peering or site-to-site VPN, mTLS endpoint for KMS proxy, firewall rules (443 only), and ability for customer agent to upload attestation bundle.

alex_solutions: Minimal items to request from customer for POC: list of HSM model + attestation cert, endpoint for KMS proxy, service account creds (scoped), rotation webhook or polling interval, and sample prompt flow to test latency.

raja_sec: Also request their MOU for log access and audit scope. For rotation proofs we need signed rotation records stored to immutable storage and accessible by customer auditors (S3 WORM or equivalent).

tim_sales: Pricing question: what's the delta for a 3-week POC?

alex_solutions: Ballpark: 5-8 eng days (integration + tests), infra provisioning if we host hardware (monthly uplift), and a one-time integration fee. I'll convert to ranges for finance.

ella_engineer: Short POC config snippet to send their infra team:
```
kms_proxy:
  mode: "peer"
  endpoint: "kms.poc.customer:443"
  auth: "mTLS"
  hsm:
    import: "split-key"
    attestation: "attestation.tar.gz"
  rotation:
    policy_days: 30
    decrypt_only_days: 90
```
Keep it minimal.

kyle_infra: Ops note: runtime change: prefix cache entries must include key_version metadata. On rotate, new writes use vN; reads accept vN-1 until TTL expires. Recommend gradual rewrap-on-write.

raja_sec: Audit spec: rotation event must include sequence number, key-id old->new, attestation verification result, signer identity, and an immutable timestamp. Store to WORM with retention policy.

legal-bot: Attach legal templates: DPA and KMS SLA snippets available at internal/legal/kmssla-v2.pdf. Any SLA that mentions key availability must be routed to legal review.

tim_sales: Action items: @alex_solutions prepare cost ranges and eng day breakdown; @kyle_infra draft network checklist + sample firewall snippet; @raja_sec author rotation log spec + DPA language; @ella_engineer produce small test harness and sample vectors. I'll schedule a 30m call with their infra lead Mon 09:30 PT.

alex_solutions: I'll draft the POC quote and list assumptions (Private recommended).

raja_sec: One more question to ask customer: will they allow attestation older than 7 days for POC? If production requires <7d, note the difference.

tim_sales: They accept <=30d for POC. We'll close the loop on production timelines later. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
